products.name: RNA Editing Therapeutics Platform (OPERA)
products.description: A proprietary platform that discovers and develops oligonucleotide-based RNA editing medicines, leveraging endogenous ADAR enzymes to make precise, transient edits to RNA for the treatment of rare and highly prevalent diseases. The platform involves physical manufacturing of synthetic oligonucleotides, machine learning-driven optimization, and established delivery modalities such as GalNAc-conjugation for subcutaneous administration.

products.name: KRRO-121 for Hyperammonemia (UCD and HE)
products.description: A GalNAc-conjugated RNA editing oligonucleotide therapeutic designed to stabilize and enhance glutamine synthetase (GS) in the liver, increasing ammonia clearance for patients with urea cycle disorders (UCD) and hepatic encephalopathy (HE). Manufactured as a synthetic oligonucleotide and delivered subcutaneously using established conjugation technology.

products.name: AATD RNA Editing Therapeutic (GalNAc-conjugated)
products.description: A next-generation GalNAc-conjugated RNA editing oligonucleotide designed to repair the pathogenic variant in the SERPINA1 gene, restoring normal alpha-1 antitrypsin (AAT) protein production in liver hepatocytes for patients with alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency (AATD). Delivered subcutaneously and manufactured using proprietary oligonucleotide chemistry.

products.name: Longevity and Liver Health RNA Editing Therapeutic (AMPKγ1 Activation)
products.description: A GalNAc-conjugated RNA editing oligonucleotide therapeutic targeting the activation of the AMPKγ1 pathway in the liver, aiming to restore metabolic status and improve liver function by creating a hyper-phosphorylated, allosterically activated AMPKγ1 protein. Delivered subcutaneously and manufactured as a synthetic oligonucleotide.

products.name: ALS RNA Editing Therapeutic (TDP-43 Modulation)
products.description: A proprietary RNA editing oligonucleotide therapeutic designed to introduce a single base edit in the TARDBP gene, generating a TDP-43 protein variant that resists aggregation and preserves normal neuronal function for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Delivered via intrathecal administration and manufactured as a synthetic oligonucleotide.

products.name: Partnered RNA Editing Programs for Cardiometabolic Diseases (Novo Nordisk Collaboration)
products.description: Research-stage RNA editing oligonucleotide therapeutics for cardiometabolic diseases, developed in collaboration with Novo Nordisk, leveraging the OPERA platform and proprietary oligonucleotide chemistry. These programs are in early research and preclinical development.

products.name: Primary Aluminum Products
products.description: Manufactured at smelters in the U.S. and Iceland, these include standard-grade aluminum ingot, sow, and value-added products such as billet and primary foundry alloy. Products are physically produced through electrolysis and casting, and delivered as solid or molten metal to customers.

products.name: Low-Carbon Aluminum Products (Natur-AlTM)
products.description: Produced at the Grundartangi facility using hydroelectric and geothermal power, these aluminum products have a low carbon footprint and are marketed for their sustainability attributes. Production involves standard smelting and casting processes with renewable energy sources.

products.name: Alumina
products.description: Produced at the Jamalco joint venture in Jamaica, alumina is refined from bauxite and sold to external customers. The process involves mining bauxite and refining it into alumina using chemical and thermal processes.

products.name: NERLYNX (neratinib)
products.description: NERLYNX is an orally administered, small-molecule irreversible tyrosine kinase inhibitor targeting HER1, HER2, and HER4, manufactured by third-party contractors and commercialized by Puma Biotechnology. It is approved and marketed for the extended adjuvant treatment of early stage HER2-positive breast cancer and, in combination with capecitabine, for advanced or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer, with distribution in the US via specialty pharmacy and distributor networks and internationally through sub-licensees.

products.name: Alisertib (investigational Aurora Kinase A inhibitor)
products.description: Alisertib is an orally administered, small-molecule, reversible, ATP-competitive inhibitor of Aurora Kinase A, manufactured by third-party contractors. Puma Biotechnology is developing and commercializing alisertib for the treatment of various cancers, with current clinical development focused on hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer and small cell lung cancer. Alisertib is not yet approved for commercial sale but is in Phase II clinical trials.

products.description: Provision of maintenance and repair services for elevators and escalators, including preventive maintenance, inspections, and repairs. Delivered by a global network of service mechanics and supported by service parts and repair centers.

products.name: Elevator and Escalator Modernization Services
products.description: Modernization services to upgrade and renew existing elevators and escalators, ranging from simple interior upgrades to complex component and subsystem replacements. Delivered through engineering, manufacturing, and on-site labor.

products.name: Digital Elevator and Escalator Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based IoT and digital solutions for real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance, and enhanced passenger experience, including Otis ONE, eView in-car display, Compass 360 destination management, and eCall Plus app. Delivered as digital services, often integrated with equipment or service contracts.

products.name: Warehouse Automation Systems for Distribution Centers
products.description: Comprehensive, modular automation systems integrating proprietary robotics, A.I.-powered software, storage structures, and vision systems to automate the movement, storage, and sorting of pallets, cases, and items in large-scale distribution centers. Delivered as capital asset purchases with installation, operation, and transfer to customer.

products.name: Micro-Fulfillment Automation Systems
products.description: Automated systems for local and store-level order fulfillment, including picking, packing, and dispatching of individual items (eaches) for e-commerce and online pickup/delivery, using robotics and A.I.-powered software. Installed in micro-fulfillment centers or attached to retail stores, supporting multiple temperature zones.

products.name: BreakPack Automation Systems
products.description: Automation systems that enable the separation of cases into individual items (eaches), packing them into totes for shipment to retail stores, reducing in-store storage and handling of slower-moving products. Integrates with case handling systems in distribution centers.

products.name: Warehouse-as-a-Service (WaaS)
products.description: Outsourced, technology-driven warehousing solutions delivered through the GreenBox joint venture, providing on-demand access to automated warehouses, advanced inventory management, and logistics services leveraging the company’s automation and A.I. systems. Customers pay for warehousing as a service rather than owning the automation systems.

products.name: Software Maintenance and Support Services
products.description: Ongoing software maintenance, updates, and technical support for deployed automation systems, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and system uptime throughout the system lifecycle. Provided as recurring services following initial system deployment.

products.name: System Operation Services
products.description: Provision of temporary operation, training, and support for automation systems after installation and before transfer of daily operations to the customer, ensuring smooth transition and optimal use of the systems.

products.name: Roluperidone
products.description: A proprietary small molecule drug candidate developed for the treatment of negative symptoms in patients with schizophrenia and potentially other CNS diseases. It is manufactured via synthetic processes by third-party contract manufacturers and is delivered as an oral medication, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: POZ-Enabled Drug Candidates for Neurological Diseases
products.description: Proprietary drug candidates using POZ polymer conjugation to enable controlled, long-acting delivery of small molecules and biologics, primarily for neurological diseases such as Parkinson’s, delivered via subcutaneous injection. These are physically manufactured pharmaceuticals requiring regulated clinical development and manufacturing.

products.name: POZ Polymer Drug Delivery Platform (Licensing and Partnerships)
products.description: Licensing and partnership of the POZ polymer drug delivery technology to third parties for use in developing their own therapeutics, including small molecules, proteins, ADCs, and RNA-based drugs. This is a technology platform delivered as intellectual property, know-how, and technical support, not as a physical product.

products.name: POZ-Lipid Conjugates for Lipid Nanoparticle (LNP) Drug Delivery
products.description: POZ-lipid conjugates designed as non-immunogenic alternatives to PEG-lipids for use in lipid nanoparticles, enabling delivery of RNA-based therapeutics and vaccines. These are manufactured chemical intermediates or excipients sold or licensed to pharmaceutical companies developing LNP-based drugs.

products.name: POZ-Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADCs)
products.description: Development and potential licensing of POZ-based antibody drug conjugates, which use the POZ polymer to attach multiple drug molecules and targeting antibodies for precision delivery in oncology and other indications. These are complex biologic drugs requiring advanced manufacturing and regulatory approval.

products.name: Wood Pellet Grills
products.description: Outdoor cooking systems that use all-natural hardwood pellets, featuring proprietary digital technologies (e.g., WiFIRE, D2 Direct Drive) and IoT connectivity, manufactured primarily in China and Vietnam and sold through retail and distributor channels.

products.name: Consumables (Wood Pellets, Rubs, and Sauces)
products.description: Traeger-branded hardwood pellets, rubs, and sauces designed for use with Traeger grills, produced primarily in the United States through vertically integrated facilities and contract manufacturers, driving recurring revenue.

products.name: Grill Accessories and Replacement Parts
products.description: A range of accessories including smart thermometers (MEATER), accessory rails, covers, drip trays, storage bins, shelves, cleaning solutions, barbecue tools, and replacement parts, manufactured by third-party suppliers and sold to enhance the grilling experience.

products.name: Digital Content (Recipes, Instructional Videos, Branded Content)
products.description: A digital library of original recipes, instructional videos, and branded content accessible via the Traeger app and website, developed by in-house and external culinary experts to educate and inspire grill owners.

products.name: Cooking Classes (Shop Class: Private Table)
products.description: Online and in-person cooking classes taught by community ambassadors and professional chefs, offering detailed instruction and interactive experiences for small groups, with ticketed participation and supplemental materials.

products.name: Traeger App
products.description: A free mobile application for iOS and Android that enables users to control and monitor their grills remotely, access recipes, and engage with the Traeger community, supporting the integrated cooking platform.

products.name: Apparel and Merchandise
products.description: Traeger-branded apparel and merchandise, including t-shirts, hooded sweatshirts, and baseball hats, produced by third-party suppliers and sold as part of the accessory product line.

products.name: Business Forms
products.description: Custom and semi-custom business forms manufactured in various sizes, colors, and formats, including snap sets, continuous forms, and laser cut sheets, produced in physical manufacturing plants and delivered primarily through independent distributors.

products.name: Labels and Tags
products.description: Custom and stock labels and tags, including pressure-sensitive and high-performance varieties, produced through physical manufacturing processes and distributed to business customers via independent distributors.

products.name: Envelopes
products.description: Custom and imprinted envelopes manufactured in various formats and quantities, distributed primarily through independent distributors and resellers.

products.name: Presentation and Document Folders
products.description: Presentation folders and document folders, custom manufactured and branded, delivered to business customers through distributors and direct sales.

products.name: Pressure-Seal Forms and Documents
products.description: Custom and stock pressure-seal forms and documents, including patented VersaSeal® products, manufactured for secure and efficient business communications.

products.name: Integrated Print Products
products.description: Integrated products combining multiple print elements (e.g., forms with labels or cards), manufactured to customer specifications and distributed through the company’s network.

products.name: Commercial Printing Services
products.description: General commercial printing services, including custom print jobs for marketing, advertising, and business communications, produced in company-owned facilities and delivered to business clients.

products.name: Financial and Security Documents
products.description: Specialized printing of financial and security documents, such as checks and secure forms, produced for banking organizations and other clients requiring regulated, secure print solutions.

products.name: Point of Purchase Advertising Products
products.description: Printed point of purchase advertising materials, such as displays and promotional items, manufactured for retail and marketing clients, primarily under the Adams McClure® brand.

products.name: School Photography Print Products
products.description: Printed products and services for school portrait photographers and photo labs, including forms and marketing materials, delivered to schools and families nationwide.

products.name: Bone Growth Therapies
products.description: Noninvasive, portable medical devices using pulsed electromagnetic field (PEMF) and low intensity pulsed ultrasound (LIPUS) technologies to stimulate bone growth and enhance fusion in spinal and non-spinal fractures. Devices are manufactured, distributed, and supported primarily in the U.S. and require regulatory approval as Class III medical devices.

products.name: Spinal Implants and Fixation Systems
products.description: Implantable devices and instrumentation for spinal fixation and fusion procedures across the cervical, thoracic, lumbar, and sacral regions. Includes pedicle screw systems, interbody spacers, plates, rods, and expandable implants, manufactured and distributed globally for use in hospitals and surgery centers.

products.name: Enabling Technologies (Surgical Navigation Systems)
products.description: Digital navigation platforms and imaging equipment, notably the 7D FLASH Navigation System, using machine vision, optical innovations, and intelligent software to guide spine and cranial surgeries. Delivered as capital equipment and software modules to hospitals and surgical centers worldwide.

products.name: Biologics (Bone Graft Substitutes and Regenerative Solutions)
products.description: A portfolio of bone graft substitutes including demineralized bone matrices (DBMs), cellular bone allografts, collagen ceramic matrices, and synthetic bone void fillers. Products are manufactured internally or sourced from partners, and are used in spinal, orthopedic, and dental procedures to promote bone regeneration.

products.name: Limb Reconstruction Solutions (External and Internal Fixation Devices)
products.description: Comprehensive external and internal fixation systems for limb reconstruction, deformity correction, limb lengthening, complex fracture management, and limb preservation. Includes circular and hexapod external fixators, intramedullary lengthening nails, and plating systems, distributed globally to hospitals and healthcare providers.

products.name: Digital Surgical Planning Platforms
products.description: Software platforms such as OrthoNext that enable pre- and postoperative planning for limb reconstruction and deformity correction procedures. Delivered as digital tools to clinicians to improve surgical preparedness and outcomes.

products.name: Specialty Property and Casualty Insurance Products
products.description: Insurance products including property and general liability coverage for small commercial businesses, vacant properties, habitational, mercantile, restaurants, bars, taverns, commercial buildings, and collectibles. Products are underwritten and distributed through agencies and are delivered via both admitted and non-admitted (E&S) insurance carriers, requiring regulated infrastructure and actuarial expertise.

products.name: Assumed Reinsurance
products.description: Proportional and excess of loss reinsurance treaties for small-to-medium sized insurers and MGAs in niche property and casualty lines, involving risk sharing and contracted through reinsurance brokers/intermediaries. Delivered via regulated insurance carriers and requires significant underwriting and capital management.

products.name: Collectibles Insurance
products.description: Direct-to-consumer property insurance coverage for owners of collectible items, including protection against theft, fire, accidental damage, and loss in transit. Delivered digitally via proprietary systems and requires specialized underwriting for niche risks.

products.name: Insurance Technology Solutions
products.description: Proprietary underwriting, policy administration, and digital distribution platforms for insurance agents and carriers, including advanced analytics, AI-enabled capabilities, and workflow automation. Delivered as technology services to both internal and external insurance industry participants.

products.name: Claims Administration Services
products.description: Claims evaluation, adjustment, and related services for property and casualty insurance, including coverage analysis, investigation, and complex claims resolution. Delivered by licensed staff and legal specialists, available to both internal and external insurance industry clients.

products.name: Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: A portfolio of innovative cancer therapies, including small molecule drugs, antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), and medical devices, delivered via oral, intravenous, or device-based methods. These products are manufactured in-house or sourced from partners and are distributed primarily in Greater China.

products.name: Immunology and Neuroscience Therapeutics
products.description: A range of biologic and small molecule therapies for autoimmune, neurological, and immunologic diseases, delivered via intravenous, subcutaneous, or oral administration. These products are developed internally or in-licensed and commercialized in Greater China.

products.name: Anti-Infective Therapeutics
products.description: Broad-spectrum antibiotics and combination antibacterial agents, available in oral and intravenous formulations, for the treatment of serious bacterial infections. These are locally manufactured or sourced from partners and sold in Greater China.

products.name: Online Marketplace Delivery Services
products.description: Digital platforms (DoorDash, Wolt, Deliveroo) that connect merchants with consumers for ordering and delivery of goods, primarily food, using a network of independent contractors (Dashers) for last-mile logistics. Delivered via mobile apps and websites, requiring regulated infrastructure and in-person labor.

products.name: Merchant Commerce Platform Services
products.description: A suite of digital tools and services enabling merchants to build, operate, and grow their own online channels, including white-label delivery fulfillment, online ordering, branded mobile apps, reservations, in-store dining management, and customer relationship management. Delivered as software and logistics services.

products.name: Advertising Services
products.description: Digital advertising solutions offered through the Marketplaces to help merchants and consumer packaged goods companies increase consumer engagement and drive incremental revenue. Delivered via online platforms integrated with the core marketplace.

products.name: Consumer Membership Programs
products.description: Subscription-based membership programs (DashPass, Wolt+, Deliveroo Plus) that provide consumers with reduced delivery and service fees and additional benefits. Delivered digitally via apps and websites.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Provides loans secured by commercial real estate properties, including owner-occupied and non-owner-occupied properties, primarily in South Florida. Loans are typically variable or fixed rate, secured by mortgages, and require underwriting and collateral evaluation.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans to individuals for the purchase, improvement, or investment in residential real estate, secured by mortgages. Includes home equity lines of credit and traditional mortgage products, with both fixed and variable rates.

products.name: Multifamily and Healthcare Real Estate Lending
products.description: Provides specialized loans for multifamily housing and healthcare properties, including skilled nursing facilities and senior housing. Includes bridge-to-HUD financing and FHA/HUD loan origination through a dedicated subsidiary.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Offers business loans and lines of credit for working capital, inventory expansion, receivables financing, and structured repayment plans. Includes asset-based lending and accounts receivable financing for businesses.

products.name: Small Business Administration (SBA) Lending
products.description: Provides SBA-guaranteed loans, including 7A loans, to small and middle market businesses. Loans are generally secured by accounts receivable, inventory, equipment, or real estate, and benefit from SBA preferred lender status.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans, primarily home equity lines of credit, to individuals. Loans are typically secured by real estate and are underwritten based on borrower creditworthiness and collateral value.

products.name: Deposit Products and Services
products.description: Provides a broad range of deposit accounts to individuals and businesses, including checking, savings, money market, NOW accounts, and certificates of deposit. Includes access to FDIC insurance, IntraFi network, and brokered deposits.

products.name: Treasury Management and Cash Management Services
products.description: Offers treasury and cash management solutions to business clients, including ACH services, wire transfers, merchant cash advance provider services, high-volume ACH transaction processing, and business operating account management.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Provides online and mobile banking platforms for retail and business customers, enabling account access, funds transfer, bill payment, remote deposit capture, and digital cash management. Includes integration with Zelle and security features.

products.name: ATM and Debit Card Services
products.description: Issues Visa debit and ATM cards, providing customers with access to cash and payment networks (Star, Presto, Cirrus) for worldwide ATM usage and point-of-sale transactions.
